request: Build a Windows version of the validated price checker. User uses Windows 11 and Steam and wants broad compatibility. Preserve the validated interface; Linux backend must keep working.
approach: Reuse shared GTK3 UI and Rust engine. Add Win32 integration, target x86_64-pc-windows-gnullvm with LLVM-MinGW UCRT and MSYS2 UCRT64 GTK3 runtime. Deliver portable ZIP when validated.
completed: Windows x64 release compiles and links, with icon, DPI/UTF-8/asInvoker manifest, tray and portable GTK runtime.

Win32 game/process detection, scoped hotkeys, guarded clipboard capture/restoration, outside close, Escape, menu/focus lifecycle, detached settings and authenticated single-instance control implemented.

125 Windows core tests and complete packaged Windows UI tests passed under isolated Wine; seven item families, real synthetic offer mods, slider + numeric input, hover, veil, foreign app keys, repeated close and settings without game.
Portable ZIP DLL closure audited (64 PE files); 167 Rust dependency license sets and runtime licenses included; 3180 extracted file hashes verified.
129 Linux core tests, full native UI regression, Clippy on both platforms and format checks passed.
incomplete: Actual PoE/Windows 11 Steam testing; standalone and mixed monitor DPI require Windows hardware.
next_steps: Copy the Windows ZIP to Windows 11, extract it entirely, start the EXE, open PoE in windowed/borderless mode and check an item with Ctrl+Alt+D.
Verify automatic league, real public Trade offers, numeric filters, hover, repeated inside/outside clicks, Escape and app switching in the real game.
